Heading to the event at Lorne Street; standing by there on management's instruction to keep a lookout for a reported serial stalker.
Standing by at Lorne Street awaiting the free food giveaway event held in remembrance of a victim.
While on standby, response call from Elliott regarding two vagrants arguing in the street.

Intercepted one of the disgruntled individuals at Mid City arcade and spoke with him about what happened; he said he had done nothing and that the other vagrant had been bothering him and physically touching his pockets.
Reassured the individual that we would look for the other man — known to us by face — and warn him not to touch people without their consent or knowledge. He was satisfied and left.
Returning to the event at Lorne Street.
While en route to the event, response call about public drinkers at the Bar 101 exit door.
Arrived at the response call and spoke to the group about keeping alcohol concealed, noting the whole CBD is a liquor-ban area. They complied.
Standing by to show presence until the group completely left the area.
Check-in at corner of Darby Street and Queen Street, all clear.
Welfare check on stores around middle Queen Street, all clear:
Response call from Hasi regarding a female individual in front of Mecca playing loud music.

Arrived at the response call; a known vagrant who often plays loud and inappropriate music. She was in a good mood today and the music was not inappropriate. We asked her to turn it down a bit; she declined, so we stood by in case anything happened.
Leaving standby; patrolling up and down Queen Street awaiting calls and incidents.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.
Response call from management to attend a response message from Edward regarding an aggressive male individual (details in the community thread).
Tracked the area all the way down to Commercial Bay; no sign of the individual.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Bodycam, 5 x Keys.
Standing by at HQ recharging the Ops Phone due to low battery (sitting at 22%); Alpha Route commenced.
Report from the Community Patrol Team of two street vagrants urinating outside at the back of their building; assistance requested to keep an eye out.

Arrived at the place of interest (timestamp as logged; follows the 14:50 report); the two individuals nowhere to be seen — Auckland Council wardens visible. Scoped out the area and moved to Federal Square, a known street-vagrant gathering spot.
Patrolling up Queen Street ensuring a strong security presence.
Arrived at 205 Queen Street; stopped by Police requesting assistance in finding out a street vagrant's name.
Police identified the individual's name; continuing patrols.
Welfare check along the Strand Arcade stores, all clear.
Check-in at Aotea Square; full sweep completed within the location, no issues found. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence.
Continuing patrols and moving along to the next checkpoint.
Welfare check along Auckland Library, all clear.
Check-in at corner of Lorne Street and Wellesley Street, no issues. Patrolling through Lorne Street with welfare checks along the water fountain and stores within the area.
Arrived back at HQ; standing by for response calls while charging the Ops Phone (battery at 11%).
Response call from Localito Convenience Store reporting an aggressive male individual causing a major disturbance inside the store and causing damage to property.
Arrived at Localito Convenience Store; two members of the public had helped the store owner calm the situation and escort the aggressor out of the premises.
Police arrived at the scene; assisting them with the incident. Standing by to keep members of the public from entering — the store is temporarily closed.
Arrived back at HQ; standing by to continue charging the Ops Phone (13%).
Floor checks completed; continuing routes and patrols with the Ops Phone at 36%.
Follow-up check on Localito Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check along Mid City shopping centre and 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
